project_type: Full-stack local-network file sharing app: Spring Boot 3 backend + React 18/Vite frontend + Playwright e2e tests
build_system: Maven 3.9 (backend, pom.xml at backend/pom.xml), npm/Vite 5 (frontend, package.json at frontend/package.json), no workspace monorepo — separate package.json per project area
test_framework: JUnit 5 + Mockito (backend unit/integration), Playwright 1.44 (e2e in e2e/)
build_command: cd backend && mvn compile -q (compile only); cd backend && mvn package -DskipTests -q (full build); cd frontend && npm run build (Vite build)
test_command: cd backend && mvn test (backend tests, ~30s); cd e2e && npx playwright test (e2e, requires running services)
verification_instructions: 1. cd backend && mvn test (must pass all ~20 tests). 2. cd frontend && npm run build (TypeScript must compile, 0 errors). 3. cd frontend && npm run lint (0 errors). 4. cd e2e && npx tsc --noEmit (TypeScript compile check without services). 5. Optionally with services running: cd e2e && npx playwright test tests/lan-mode.spec.ts
snapshot_or_generated_files: backend/src/main/resources/static/ — generated by start-lan.ps1 (npm run build then copy); this directory should NOT be committed. A .gitkeep file should exist to preserve the empty dir.
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell. Backend port is 8787 (NOT 8080 — this is a critical distinction; many files still have 8080 which is wrong). Backend binds to 0.0.0.0:8787. Frontend dev server is 5173. No PostgreSQL, no Docker required for development. Java 21 required (pom.xml sets maven.compiler.source=21). Lombok requires annotation processor path in maven-compiler-plugin (already configured).
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md or CONTRIBUTING.md exists yet — one is being created. Follow existing Spring Boot/Lombok/React patterns. No new dependencies without strong justification.
key_patterns: Backend: @RequiredArgsConstructor Lombok for DI, @Slf4j for logging (SLF4J only, no System.out.println), @ConfigurationProperties for config binding, interface + LocalImpl pattern for storage. Frontend: functional components with hooks, Tailwind CSS for styling, react-hot-toast for notifications, lucide-react for icons, axios client with localStorage-based baseURL override for LAN mode. E2E: helpers.ts provides shared API helpers (uploadFileViaApi, apiGet/Post/Delete, hashFile/Buffer), tests use API_URL = process.env.API_URL || 'http://localhost:8787'.
directory_structure: QR-CODE/ root: README.md, LAN-REPORT.md, docker-compose.yml, .env.example, .gitignore, start-lan.ps1, start-dev.ps1. backend/: Spring Boot app (port 8787). frontend/: React/Vite app (dev port 5173). e2e/: Playwright tests. e2e/demo/: standalone live-demo script. test-files/: binary/text fixtures used by e2e tests. .agents/tasks/: planning artifacts from this session.
